source_snapshot.version_description:
The current version of GHCN Daily is 3.35-upd-2026102517 (i.e, an update that started at 2026102517 [yyyymmddhh] UTC; yyyy=year; mm=month; dd=day; hh=hour),
created by appending recently available data updates to the last fully reprocessed version: 3.35-por-2026101623.

methodology.source: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily .dly, core TMAX, TMIN, PRCP; snapshot preserved with SHA256.
methodology.qc: Reject -9999 and every nonblank QFLAG. Preserve nonblank measurement/source flag counts. Blank QFLAG means no failed GHCN checks, not proof of perfect measurement. Trace precipitation contributes reported 0 mm.
methodology.mean_temperature: Daily (TMAX+TMIN)/2, averaged across valid paired days; not GHCN TAVG or 24-hour mean.
methodology.period_means: Equal weight for each valid annual aggregate; monthly climatology equally weights each valid year for that calendar month.
methodology.coverage_rule: Temperature means require >=95% valid daily coverage. Counts, precipitation sums, daily maxima and degree-day sums require 100%; otherwise null. No imputation or prorating.
methodology.hot_days_32_2c: Count TMAX >=32.2 degC; 90 degF is 32.222... degC, rounded to 32.2 to match the archive's 0.1 degC encoding. Do not apply exact 32.222 to rounded observations.
methodology.tropical_nights_gt20c: Count daily TMIN >20 degC (ETCCDI/Climpact TR definition); not Korea's >=25 degC overnight definition and not an hourly sunset-to-sunrise measurement.
methodology.warm_nights_ge23_9c: Count TMIN >=23.9 degC, 75 degF rounded to archive precision.
methodology.precipitation: PRCP daily water-equivalent precipitation, tenths mm converted to mm; may include melted snowfall. rx1day_mm is maximum reported daily total, not a rolling 24h or 1h extreme.
methodology.degree_days: Sum max(0,Tmean-18) for CDD and max(0,18-Tmean) for HDD, in degC-days; proxy climate demand, not kWh or design load.
methodology.normals_status: These are reproducible unadjusted derived baseline statistics, NOT official NOAA 1991-2020 Climate Normals (which use further processing).
methodology.spatial_assignment: Nearest station uses haversine distance to provided latitude/longitude and returns reference-station context only. Do not interpolate, portray as building temperature, or treat Newark as a rural UHI control.

limitations: A five-year recent period is weather/climate context, not a new 30-year normal or attribution study.
Station siting, relocations, observation practices, airport/park surroundings and ocean proximity affect comparisons.
Daily temperature and precipitation do not provide humidity, heat index, WBGT, cooling peaks, subdaily rainfall, flood depth or financial losses.
No 2026 observations are included; no station values are forecasts or parcel-scale measurements.
